summary: Text field with a filterable list of suggestions for single selection, with support for async results provided by the consumer.
whenToUse: Long lists where the user knows the value to search for.
Remote searches: the component makes no network requests; you handle fetch/debounce.
whenNotToUse: Few options: use Select or RadioGroup.

props.name: items
props.description: Options already filtered by the consumer (async mode): no internal filtering.

props.name: allowsCustomValue
props.description: Allows text that does not match an option.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a spinner and a localized loading message.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Message shown when there are no results (localized default).

props.name: inputRef / inputProps / popoverProps
props.description: Access to the input and the popover.

inherits: Props of the react-aria-components ComboBox (name, isRequired, validate…).

keyboard.action: Opens the list and moves the active option.
Closes the list; pressing it again restores the text.

accessibility: APG Combobox pattern with aria-activedescendant: focus stays in the input.
The number of results is announced to screen readers.
responsive: The popover matches the field width; on touch it opens when the arrow button is tapped.
customization: Same anatomy as TextField; startAdornment for an icon.
commonMistakes: Passing items (unfiltered) and expecting internal filtering: use defaultItems.
Making a network request on every keystroke without debouncing or cancellation.
